prev_agent: Done! Now all the badges (Processing, Succeeded, Failed) will use the **same zinc colors** for their numbers: - **Selected**: `text-zinc-100` - **Unselected**: `text-zinc-400` This should make them all match consistently in light mode. The issue was that Succeeded/Failed were using semantic colors (`text-accent-foreground`, `text-muted-foreground`) which had different contrast than the explicit zinc colors used in Processing.
